feedback: 3 akshara(s) had alpaprana/mahaprana (aspiration) confusion -- practice minimal pairs like त/थ, क/ख, प/फ with a hand in front of the mouth to feel the puff of air on mahaprana sounds.
4 sanyukta akshara(s) (conjuncts) were altered -- slow the cluster down and articulate every consonant in it distinctly.

rubric2.name: Anunasika (nasalisation)
feedback: 6 anunasika akshara(s) used the wrong nasal -- remember the nasal must match the place of articulation of the consonant that follows it (e.g. the 'ng' in गङ्गा is velar because ग is velar; saying गम्गा or गन्गा substitutes a labial/dental nasal instead).
